web_fixture.content:
# Artifact retention

Grimsdale reference, reviewed 2026-07-02.

| setting | default |
| --- | --- |
| build_log_keep_days | 27 |
| binary_keep_days | 90 |
| upload_timeout_seconds | 45 |
| max_artifact_mib | 512 |

A build log is kept for build_log_keep_days from the day its build finishes and
is then deleted; no second copy is written anywhere. Binaries follow
binary_keep_days, which counts from the same day but is a separate setting, so a
build can leave its log behind after the binary itself is gone.

upload_timeout_seconds bounds one upload request. max_artifact_mib caps a single
artifact, and a larger artifact is refused while it is uploaded.

turns.prompt: Grimsdale keeps the build logs for our release train and nobody has changed any of its retention settings. How many days after a build finishes does its log stay available? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
